g.text: "Bring EVERYTHING in a bag" → list (name/dose/time/reason/prescriber) → compare vs chart →
resolve (omissions? duplications? OTC/herbal? expired?) → document ONE true list → counsel →
share (folder + patient card + family). Catches: double paracetamol, dead drugs, borrowed pills.
CAN'T
cost, distance,
eyes/hands, swallow
generics, blister,
liquids, aids
FORGETS
memory, complex
regimes, no routine
pill box, alarms,
family DOT, simplify
WON'T
side effects, "cured",
beliefs, mistrust
listen, fix effects,
teach-back, negotiate
DEPRESCRIBING (5 steps, with doctor + pharmacist + elder): 1 list ALL (brown bag) →
2 match indication (no reason = candidate) → 3 benefit vs harm NOW (frailty/goals change
maths — statin at 88 with CFS 7? discuss) → 4 taper/stop ONE at a time (benzodiazepines,
anticholinergics, PPIs-without-cause, duplicate paracetamol, dead supplements) → 5 monitor
+ document + tell family what to watch. NEVER abrupt: benzos, steroids, beta-blockers,
antidepressants, antiparkinson — taper per protocol. Stopping well = prescribing well.
SIMPLIFY wins adherence: once-daily where possible, align times (morning/evening), pill
boxes + blister packs, big-print lists with REASONS (\"white — BP — morning\"), teach-back
(M02 PRO-II), family DOT for dementia, phone alarms, refill synced to one date.
MONITOR the risky: anticoag (bleeds + falls + INRs), insulin/sulfonylureas (hypo plan +
glucose + family trained), diuretics (weight + K+ + kidney), opioids (bowels + sedation),
digoxin (levels + K+ + vision), lithium (levels + fluids). Diaries beat memory: BP, glucose,
weight, pain, bowels — reviewed each visit, doses adjusted, harms caught early.
Nurse's power: you see the bag, the home, the confusion, the fall — flag Beers drugs,
cascades and non-adherence UP (ISBAR to doctor/pharmacist — PRO-I M5) and counsel DOWN
with teach-back. Document lists + counsel + plans (PRO-I M5).
